verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 46.2
verses.english: Linked Discourses 46.2

verses.pali: 1. Pabbatavagga
verses.english: 1. Mountains

verses.pali: Kāyasutta
verses.english: The Body

verses.pali: Sāvatthinidānaṁ.
verses.english: At Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ayaṁ kāyo āhāraṭṭhitiko, āhāraṁ paṭicca tiṭṭhati, anāhāro no tiṭṭhati;
verses.english: “Mendicants, this body is sustained by food. It depends on food to continue, and without food it doesn’t continue.

verses.pali: evameva kho, bhikkhave, pañca nīvaraṇā āhāraṭṭhitikā, āhāraṁ paṭicca tiṭṭhanti, anāhārā no tiṭṭhanti.
verses.english: In the same way, the five hindrances are sustained by fuel. They depend on fuel to continue, and without fuel they don’t continue.

verses.pali: Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā kāmacchandassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā kāmacchandassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya?
verses.english: And what fuels the arising of sensual desire, or, when it has arisen, makes it increase and grow?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, subhanimittaṁ.
verses.english: There is the feature of beauty.

verses.pali: Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro—
verses.english: Frequent irrational application of mind to that

verses.pali: ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā kāmacchandassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā kāmacchandassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
verses.english: fuels the arising of sensual desire, or, when it has arisen, makes it increase and grow.

verses.pali: Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā byāpādassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā byāpādassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya?
verses.english: And what fuels the arising of ill will, or, when it has arisen, makes it increase and grow?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, paṭighanimittaṁ.
verses.english: There is the feature of aversion.

verses.pali: Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro—
verses.english: Frequent irrational application of mind to that

verses.pali: ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā byāpādassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā byāpādassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
verses.english: fuels the arising of ill will, or, when it has arisen, makes it increase and grow.

verses.pali: Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā thinamiddhassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā thinamiddhassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya?
verses.english: And what fuels the arising of dullness and drowsiness, or, when they have arisen, makes them increase and grow?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, arati tandi vijambhitā bhattasammado cetaso ca līnattaṁ.
verses.english: There is discontent, sloth, yawning, sleepiness after eating, and mental sluggishness.

verses.pali: Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro—
verses.english: Frequent irrational application of mind to them

verses.pali: ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā thinamiddhassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā thinamiddhassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
verses.english: fuels the arising of dullness and drowsiness, or, when they have arisen, makes them increase and grow.

verses.pali: Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya?
verses.english: And what fuels the arising of restlessness and remorse, or, when they have arisen, makes them increase and grow?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, cetaso avūpasamo.
verses.english: There is the unsettled mind.

verses.pali: Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro—
verses.english: Frequent irrational application of mind to that

verses.pali: ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
verses.english: fuels the arising of restlessness and remorse, or, when they have arisen, makes them increase and grow.

verses.pali: Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannāya vā vicikicchāya uppādāya, uppannāya vā vicikicchāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya?
verses.english: And what fuels the arising of doubt, or, when it has arisen, makes it increase and grow?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, vicikicchāṭṭhānīyā dhammā.
verses.english: There are things that are grounds for doubt.

verses.pali: Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro—
verses.english: Frequent irrational application of mind to them

verses.pali: ayamāhāro anuppannāya vā vicikicchāya uppādāya, uppannāya vā vicikicchāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
verses.english: fuels the arising of doubt, or, when it has arisen, makes it increase and grow.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ayaṁ kāyo āhāraṭṭhitiko, āhāraṁ paṭicca tiṭṭhati, anāhāro no tiṭṭhati;
verses.english: This body is sustained by food. It depends on food to continue, and without food it doesn’t continue.

verses.pali: evameva kho, bhikkhave, ime pañca nīvaraṇā āhāraṭṭhitikā, āhāraṁ paṭicca tiṭṭhanti, anāhārā no tiṭṭhanti.
verses.english: In the same way, the five hindrances are sustained by fuel. They depend on fuel to continue, and without fuel they don’t continue.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ayaṁ kāyo āhāraṭṭhitiko, āhāraṁ paṭicca tiṭṭhati, anāhāro no tiṭṭhati;
verses.english: This body is sustained by food. It depends on food to continue, and without food it doesn’t continue.

verses.pali: evameva kho, bhikkhave, satta bojjhaṅgā āhāraṭṭhitikā, āhāraṁ paṭicca tiṭṭhanti, anāhārā no tiṭṭhanti.
verses.english: In the same way, the seven awakening factors are sustained by fuel. They depend on fuel to continue, and without fuel they don’t continue.

verses.pali: Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā?
verses.english: And what fuels the arising of the awakening factor of mindfulness, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, satisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā.
verses.english: There are things that are grounds for the awakening factor of mindfulness.

verses.pali: Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro—
verses.english: Frequent rational application of mind to them

verses.pali: ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
verses.english: fuels the arising of the awakening factor of mindfulness, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it.

verses.pali: Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā?
verses.english: And what fuels the arising of the awakening factor of investigation of principles, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, kusalākusalā dhammā, sāvajjānavajjā dhammā, hīnapaṇītā dhammā, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā.
verses.english: There are qualities that are skillful and unskillful, blameworthy and blameless, inferior and superior, and those with a portion of dark or bright.

verses.pali: Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro—
verses.english: Frequent rational application of mind to them

verses.pali: ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
verses.english: fuels the arising of the awakening factor of investigation of principles, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it.

verses.pali: Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā?
verses.english: And what fuels the arising of the awakening factor of energy, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, ārambhadhātu nikkamadhātu parakkamadhātu.
verses.english: There are the elements of initiative, persistence, and exertion.

verses.pali: Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro—
verses.english: Frequent rational application of mind to them

verses.pali: ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
verses.english: fuels the arising of the awakening factor of energy, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it.

verses.pali: Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā?
verses.english: And what fuels the arising of the awakening factor of rapture, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, pītisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā.
verses.english: There are things that are grounds for the awakening factor of rapture.

verses.pali: Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro—
verses.english: Frequent rational application of mind to them

verses.pali: ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
verses.english: fuels the arising of the awakening factor of rapture, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it.

verses.pali: Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā?
verses.english: And what fuels the arising of the awakening factor of tranquility, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, kāyapassaddhi, cittapassaddhi.
verses.english: There is tranquility of the body and of the mind.

verses.pali: Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro—
verses.english: Frequent rational application of mind to that

verses.pali: ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
verses.english: fuels the arising of the awakening factor of tranquility, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it.

verses.pali: Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā?
verses.english: And what fuels the arising of the awakening factor of immersion, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, samathanimittaṁ abyagganimittaṁ.
verses.english: There are things that are the basis of serenity and freedom from distraction.

verses.pali: Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro—
verses.english: Frequent rational application of mind to them

verses.pali: ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
verses.english: fuels the arising of the awakening factor of immersion, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it.

verses.pali: Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā?
verses.english: And what fuels the arising of the awakening factor of equanimity, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā.
verses.english: There are things that are grounds for the awakening factor of equanimity.

verses.pali: Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro—
verses.english: Frequent rational application of mind to them

verses.pali: ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
verses.english: fuels the arising of the awakening factor of equanimity, or, when it has arisen, fully develops it.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ayaṁ kāyo āhāraṭṭhitiko, āhāraṁ paṭicca tiṭṭhati, anāhāro no tiṭṭhati;
verses.english: This body is sustained by food. It depends on food to continue, and without food it doesn’t continue.

verses.pali: evameva kho, bhikkhave, ime satta bojjhaṅgā āhāraṭṭhitikā, āhāraṁ paṭicca tiṭṭhanti, anāhārā no tiṭṭhantī”ti.
verses.english: In the same way, the seven awakening factors are sustained by fuel. They depend on fuel to continue, and without fuel they don’t continue.”

verses.pali: Dutiyaṁ.
